annotations.title: A page to upload a clip for a free running-form check

description: A link to a Sigwren page where a runner uploads one short clip of themselves running (side-on, 30 seconds or less) for a free running-form check. Sigwren reads the clip once and gives back what the runner does well, what to work on, one focus with a drill, and cues to run with. The clip is deleted as soon as it has been read, and the full read is emailed to the address the runner gives on the page. Each email address gets one free check. The page asks for the clip, an email address, and a tick to confirm the clip is the runner, that they are 18 or over, and that anyone else in it agreed to be filmed. Afterwards, get_test_result with this link returns a summary for the assistant to explain. Each call makes a new link. It needs no account. With the person's "Check with me first" setting on (the default), a call without a confirmation makes no change: it returns a description of the change and a confirmation value, and the change is held for the person to approve. The same call with that confirmation value makes it. With the setting off, the change is made straight away.

confirmation.description: The confirmation value from an earlier call of this tool with the same arguments, once the person has approved the change it described. Without it, Sigwren describes the change and makes none.
